defects.summary: The 'refused by the launch control' arm's homeWhenProbed checks only that coai-vh is not empty, which the row's reservation already makes true before KimiLaunch builds kh-*, so it does not prove what deviation 55 says (that the home existed when the probe ran).

S5.6.7's Then says the row's scratch is gone after every ending, but the two refused arms check only coai-vh, the recorder and the person's folder; only the answered and cancelled arms check the scratch.
The Scopes class and the StandIn helper are copied from AKimiConsultationScenarioTests a second and third time (here and in AKimiQuestionRowTests), where one shared helper would do.
KimiConsultantOn builds a second Kimi adapter beside the existing kimi entry in Adapters() of the same class instead of reusing that entry.
Deviation 55 cites 'the C3 review's R1' and '(R2)', and neither of those reviews is recorded anywhere in the plan.
S5.5.1 checks only that the canary state is not 'read' and does not pin the exact state that the played 'CANNOT' answer gives.
